A '''march''' was a type of [[Music/Legends|music]]. The [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] was scheduled to perform several [[Neoclassical period|Neoclassical]] marches from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] era during its [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] tour starting in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
